name: Hinomiya Kazuteru
source:
"We've had plenty of time to get to know each other deeper and exchange words. But we can still become even more close with each other."

The wild romanticist 'king' of Mars.
The Mars Prince.

An Ore-sama type guy who is very curious.
That curious spirit often gets him wrapped up in trouble, but it also leads him to make the right decisions to lead people when the time comes.
Even though he's still just a prince, he acts like a king.
He owns a white tiger named 'Raian' that acts as his bodyguard.
